sources.name: Master Addresses List (street cleaning district of each address)

words.rule: Each side of a residential street is swept once a month, April to December, on the day on its signs (like "2nd Thursday"), 8 AM to noon on most streets.
words.afterpass: April to December. $100 ticket, no tow. A sweep that falls on a City holiday moves to a make-up day, and the dates here include it. A few streets post other hours: the sign decides.
words.dataNotes: Dates from the City's 2026 Street Sweeping Schedule (Public Works, on the City's open data), which gives each street cleaning district's odd and even sides their own day, holiday make-up days included. Each block side takes the district of its addresses in the City's Master Addresses List, placed by the City's street centerline address ranges. The City publishes no hours: most streets are 8 AM to noon, so the posted sign decides.
